The city council met on Tuesday to discuss a resolution to remove the city from a new state commission on homelessness due to its lack of affordable housing choices. That resolution was approved by the 6 to 1 vote at the meeting. It had been opposed by the city council, where two major changes were expected: less government oversight of the local housing market and greater use of the current tax dollars to help support affordable housing. The mayor cited the council for taking advantage of the law in place. City council president Joseph F. H. Thompson said he did not expect the council to allow the council to remove housing from the market. H. Thompson said that
